name: Star Plus Legend Holdings Limited
summary: Star Plus Legend Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in retail and IP creation and operation businesses in the People's Republic of China. The company is involved in the development and sale of health management and skincare products through a network of distributors and sub-distributors, and e-commerce channels, including online stores operated on social media platform. It also creates and/or manages celebrity Ips; provides planning and management services to the production of media contents and events; and licenses its celebrity Ips, as well as sells related products.
